product_name: Alcatel V3 Ultra 5G (Champagne Gold, 8GB+128GB) | India’s 1st Patented NXTPAPER Superior Display |Segment's 1st Smartphone with Stylus | 108MP Ultra Pixel Camera | eSIM, NFC | with Charger
description: India’s 1st Patented NXTPAPER Display - A segment-first 6.78" full-color electronic paper smartphone with 120Hz refresh rate. Its anti-glare screen mimics real paper for eye comfort, even in sunlight. TÜV, SGS & Eyesafe certified, it cuts 61% blue light. With adaptive modes, stylus support & NXTPAPER Key (Max Ink, Ink Paper, Color Paper), enjoy clarity, comfort & effortless reading or note-taking. 108MP Ultra Pixel Camera - Capture pro-level content with a flagship 108MP main camera, supported by an 8MP ultra-wide and 2MP macro lens. The 32MP selfie camera delivers crystal-clear portraits in any light. With features like Horizon Lock and Motion Capture, shoot steady action shots, vlog seamlessly, or video call with unmatched clarity. Backed by Google Photos AI tools like Magic Editor, Magic Eraser, and Photo Unblur, enhance every memory with studio-quality edits right on your phone. AI-Powered Performance & Smart Storage - Enjoy lightning-fast 5G speeds and powerful multitasking with the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor and up to 16GB RAM (8GB + 8GB RAM Expansion). Store more with 128GB storage expandable to 2TB via microSD. AI capabilities powered by Gemini help summarize, draft, and organize content effortlessly. Seamless compatibility with Google apps like YouTube, Tasks, and Keep makes this smartphone your ultimate productivity companion. Long-Lasting Battery, Dual SIM Flexibility & NFC Payments - Power through your day with a 5010mAh battery and recharge swiftly with 33W fast charging. Enjoy seamless global connectivity with Dual SIM support (Physical SIM + eSIM), ideal for frequent travelers and digital nomads. Make quick, secure contactless payments with built-in NFC - no need to carry cards or cash. Whether commuting or shopping, experience unmatched convenience with smart, secure tech in your hands. Rugged & Entertaining - Protected with IP54-rated splash and dust resistance, this phone is built to handle everyday accidents - from sudden rain to rough environments. Dual DTS stereo speakers deliver rich, cinema-like surround sound for immersive streaming, gaming, or movie nights. Backed by 3 years of OS updates and 4 years of security updates, it’s designed for durability, entertainment, and long-term reliability.
